summary: The legal task list is capped at 100 rows, which is too small for a stable runtime-scaling distinction between a minimum scan and sorting or repeated comparisons.

workload_bound.source_constraint: 1 <= n == tasks.length <= 100, with start and duration each between 1 and 100

replacement_checks.evidence: The accepted implementation evaluates one start-plus-duration sum for each of at most 100 task rows and maintains one minimum, establishing O(n) time and O(1) auxiliary space.

The certificate regression checks all 10,000 legal singleton tasks, then 5,000 deterministic legal arrays spanning every length from 1 through 100 and explicit extrema against a direct completion-time oracle.
